messages:
maria: heads up — i'm planning to enable route-by-cost for canary traffic (10%) in usaprod tomorrow 09:00 PST. quick q: should we add a safemode debounce to avoid routing thrash during short bursts?
kevin: depends on burst shape. if bursts are sub-1m, debounce+cooldown helps. what metrics would you want to gate on? p95? error rate?
sam: p95 + request_rate per shard worked for us during the Q3 spike test. we saw oscillation -> route flip-flop when a single node blipped. :eyes:
maria: current rollout plan: dry-run for 30m then lift dry_run if signals look good. I'll run this command tomorrow in the window:
```
redwoodctl feature set --name route_by_cost --percent 10 --dry-run true --env usaprod
```
kevin: propose adding explicit fields to the feature config: cooldown_secs, min_sample_size, metric_window, and a small hysteresis threshold. sample YAML idea:
```yaml
route_by_cost:
  percent: 10
  dry_run: true
  cooldown_secs: 300  # don't change routing again for 5m
  min_sample_size: 500
  metric_window_secs: 60
  hysteresis_pct: 0.10
  grace_count: 3  # require 3 consecutive windows to change state
```
elaine: console/ux ask: show a "safety preview" that simulates routing delta (how many requests move, projected token-cost delta) before commit. also surface telemetry gates (p95 threshold, min_sample_size) inline in the rollout modal.
maria: good call. i'd also like a dry-run preview that shows a sample of requests that would have been routed differently (anonymized) so SREs can eyeball.
sam: telemetry gating rules we used previously: require stable metrics across 2 consecutive windows (5m each) and no >20% spike in errors. if gate fails, the flag should auto-fail to prior routing and open an alert. also add an emergency circuit-breaker route fallback -> default routing.
devops-bot: rollout scheduled: id=rbc-20260320-01, owner=maria, channel=eng-platform, start=2026-03-20T09:00:00-08:00, mode=canary(10%), dry_run=true
kevin: small audit note: ensure the rollout stores the commit hash, full config blob, and who initiated the rollout in the audit log. dry_run should still sample and persist request traces for replay.
maria: i'll update the RFC with the YAML fields and console mock. will add an oncall checklist (how to abort, metrics to watch, quick rollback commands). thanks everyone :rocket:
